title: Reduced steady rigid-rotation velocity and vorticity field
description: Conditional analytic field for a fluid with explicitly prescribed constant angular velocity. Not a general Navier-Stokes solver or an inferred TF1766 coupling.
assumptions: REDUCED MODEL: steady incompressible Newtonian fluid in rigid rotation.
The caller prescribes Omega, positive uniform density and coordinates inside a cylinder with declared radius R.
The wall rotates at Omega R; no axial flow; no body forcing; radial pressure balances centripetal acceleration.
mechanism: A prescribed rotating boundary and pressure gradient support the declared steady field. No universal frequency mechanism is asserted.
falsification_conditions: Finite-difference curl disagrees with 2 Omega in the tested numerical domain.
Radial pressure acceleration does not balance convective acceleration.
